definition_english: Denoting a stipulated face, benchmark, imputed, or unconstrained reference figure used to calculate contractual cash flows, derivative exposure, taxable annual value, or theoretical Walrasian market plans without actual principal exchange, cash outlay, or quantity-constrained market realization.
definition_hindi: वास्तविक मूलधन के आदान-प्रदान, नकद व्यय अथवा मात्रा-बाधित बाज़ार निष्पादन के बिना संविदात्मक नकदी प्रवाह, व्युत्पन्नी जोखिम, करयोग्य वार्षिक मूल्य अथवा सैद्धांतिक वालरासी बाज़ार योजनाओं की गणना के लिए निर्धारित अंकित, मानक, आरोपित या अबाधित संदर्भ राशि को सूचित करने वाला।

etymology.root_language: Latin (via Middle English and Medieval Latin)
etymology.historical_development: Formed from notion + -al (Latin -ālis). Specialized economics usage emerged in 1958; Robert Clower formalized unconstrained Walrasian notional demand against quantity-constrained effective demand in 1965, paralleling modern financial derivative notional principal/value and statutory deemed rental taxation.

equivalence_mapping.usage_status: Directly attested in exact 1:1 bilingual RBI FERR FAQs (Oct 2026) as कल्पित मूल्य (notional value) and कल्पित राशि (notional amount); standalone CSTT entry not yet established
Directly attested in SEBI Hindi statistical annexures (2025-2026) as आनुमानिक मूल्य and आनुमानिक रूप से; implies estimation rather than stipulated contractual base
Directly attested in Income Tax India Schedule HP (May 2026) as काल्पनिक किराया (notional rent) and काल्पनिक आधार पर
Directly attested in SEBI Hindi statistical annexures (2025-2026) in market jargon (प्रीमियम नोशनल)
Dictionary-attested in Shabdkosh for estimated cost benchmarks (अनुमानित लागत for notional cost)
Attested alongside काल्पनिक किराया in Income Tax India Schedule HP (मानित किराया आय for deemed rental income)
Attested in Income Tax India Hindi portal for deemed let-out house property (प्रकल्पित किराये पर दी गई गृह संपत्ति)
Dictionary-attested for theoretical; applicable when contrasting unconstrained macroeconomic plans against realized effective demand

syntactic_patterns: non-gradable classifying attributive modifier before financial, tax, and economic nouns (notional value, notional rent, notional demand)
adverbial modifier setting up contrast with realized execution (notionally)

syntactic_patterns: attributive pre-nominal modifier before masculine or feminine financial nouns (कल्पित मूल्य m. sg., कल्पित राशि f. sg.)
genitive reference frame with का/की/के (संविदा का कल्पित मूल्य, व्युत्पन्नी संविदा की कल्पित राशि)

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: High statutory, financial-regulatory, and macroeconomic Tatsama register
register_and_pragmatics.connotation: Neutral-analytical; denotes a formally stipulated or imputed calculation base without physical principal transfer
cultural_nuances: Indian financial regulators diverge directly on the same English compound: RBI standardizes कल्पित मूल्य while SEBI employs आनुमानिक मूल्य alongside market loanword प्रीमियम नोशनल, and Income Tax India uses काल्पनिक किराया paired with मानित and प्रकल्पित.
usage_restrictions: Prefer कल्पित over आनुमानिक for fixed contractual derivative principals and swaps where the figure is stipulated rather than estimated.
Do not use सांकेतिक (nominal/symbolic) for derivative notional value, which can represent large exposures rather than token sums.
Reject documented Shabdkosh mistranslations: काल्पनिक प्रधान (for notional principal), राजकीय किराया (for notional rental), कल्चरल बैंक (for notional bank), and व्यावहारिक रूप से (for notionally).
Do not use अवधारणात्मक or धारणात्मक in tax assessments or derivative contracts.

linguistic_analysis.morphosyntax: English notional acts as a non-gradable classifying adjective in S3. Hindi कल्पित (√kalp + -ita), आनुमानिक (anumāna + -ika with vṛddhi), and काल्पनिक (kalpanā + -ika with vṛddhi) are all invariable Tatsama adjectives; agreement is controlled strictly by the modified head noun (e.g., masculine मूल्य, किराया; feminine राशि, लागत, आय).
linguistic_analysis.morphological_distinction: The participial form कल्पित ('arranged, posited, assumed') expresses a deliberate analytical or contractual posit, whereas आनुमानिक ('conjectural, estimative') implies inference and काल्पनिक ('pertaining to imagination') invokes colloquial fiction.

conceptual_analysis.core_distinction: Separates a stipulated contractual reference base (notional principal/value), statutory deemed annual value (notional rent), or unconstrained Walrasian plan (notional demand) from realized cash principal exchange, actual market value, or quantity-constrained effective demand.
conceptual_analysis.domain_boundary: Distinct from S1 philosophical abstraction, S2 civil-service paper progression, and S4 semantic grammatical concord.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both translate English 'notional value' in live Indian financial regulatory texts (RBI vs. SEBI).
pairwise_comparison.difference: कल्पित denotes a posited/stipulated reference figure suited to fixed derivative contracts (swaps, options), whereas आनुमानिक denotes conjecture or estimation (अनुमान पर आश्रित), better suited to estimated cost benchmarks than fixed contractual principals.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Low in rigorous derivatives regulation; prefer कल्पित for contractual reference bases and आनुमानिक only for estimated or approximated metrics.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both derive from Sanskrit √kalp- and appear in Indian financial and tax texts.
pairwise_comparison.difference: कल्पित conveys an analytical or contractual posit cleanly, while काल्पनिक carries strong everyday connotations of imaginary or fabricated (फ़र्ज़ी/मनगढ़ंत) despite being attested in Income Tax Schedule HP for notional rent.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Partial; prefer कल्पित in derivatives and accounting, while recognizing काल्पनिक किराया as attested in Income Tax India Schedule HP.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both appear in economic and administrative contexts describing non-physical values.
pairwise_comparison.difference: सांकेतिक corresponds to nominal/symbolic (minimal or token), whereas कल्पित denotes a stipulated calculation base (notional) whose scale may be very large.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Not interchangeable; substituting सांकेतिक for derivative notional value distorts financial exposure.

proposed_terminology.justification: RBI's कल्पित is morphologically sound and institutionally attested for contractual reference values; inter-agency harmonization across RBI, SEBI, Income Tax India, and CSTT is needed rather than a neologism.

overall_confidence: Moderate-High — RBI (कल्पित), SEBI (आनुमानिक / नोशनल), and Income Tax India (काल्पनिक / मानित / प्रकल्पित) usages are directly verified in opened primary documents, though inter-regulatory harmonization, standalone CSTT verification, and Hindi macroeconomic standardization for Clower's notional demand remain unresolved.
